code_quality_findings.issue: M-REWRITE.5 (BA spec line 202) requires 'Post-sed diff verifier: diff -u $SANDBOX/scripts/<name>.sh.orig $SANDBOX/scripts/<name>.sh MUST show ONLY the named lines as changed (no accidental wildcard matches). Asserts diff line count equals expected change count.' This Must-Have requirement is unimplemented. The rewrite functions do create $dst.orig (lines 52, 136) but never invoke a diff verifier on the pair.
code_quality_findings.recommendation: Add diff verifier function in tests/lib/rewrite.sh after each rewrite that runs `diff -u $dst.orig $dst | grep -c '^[+-]'` and asserts the change count matches the number of expected substitutions per script (deploy: ~5+3 daemon-block lines; rollback: ~6+3 daemon-block lines). This catches accidental wildcard sed matches that the per-pattern _assert_pattern_unique cannot detect at substitution time. Non-blocking for this cycle because M-REWRITE.4 (unique-match assertion before each substitution) + M-PATHSCAN (post-rewrite leak detection) provide overlapping defense; the actual rewrites are demonstrably correct (full suite passes 24/24, md5 unchanged).
